sql_templates.description: Get FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index confirmation for the last 3 months.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_dates AS (
                SELECT 
                    MAX(trade_date) AS max_date
                FROM 
                    signals.fii_dii_flows
                WHERE 
                    trade_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
            )
            SELECT 
                f.trade_date, 
                f.fii_net_today, 
                f.dii_net_today, 
                r.regime, 
                r.confidence,
                m.advances, 
                m.declines, 
                m.market_sentiment,
                i.close AS index_close,
                i.trend_signal
            FROM 
                signals.fii_dii_flows f
            JOIN 
                signals.regime_history r
            ON 
                f.trade_date = r.trade_date
            JOIN 
                breadth.market_daily m
            ON 
                f.trade_date = m.trade_date
            JOIN 
                market.index_eod i
            ON 
                f.trade_date = i.trade_date
            WHERE 
                f.trade_date >= (SELECT max_date FROM latest_dates)
                AND i.index_symbol = 'NIFTY 50'
            ORDER BY 
                f.trade_date DESC
